state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

A `Core\Task` child is now held to its request's memory ceiling. `Ctx::child` in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/isolate.rs` copies the parent's memory zero point, ceiling and limit-handler reserve, so a child reads the whole request's balance on its core and stops at its own next poll. Each child's 1 MiB stack reservation is charged by `Child::new` in `crates/nvs-host/src/group.rs` and given back by `Child`'s `Drop`, per `rule:concurrency/a-task-stack-is-reserved-wide-and-pooled`. The two tests `a_child_s_stack_is_charged_to_the_request_while_it_runs` and `a_child_whose_stack_passes_the_request_s_ceiling_is_over_it` pin it, and `tests/hostile/core/Task/all/02-groups-nested-past-the-memory-limit.nvs` now passes with no gap marker. Gap `a-task-stack-is-not-charged-to-its-request` is deleted.

`[limits] max_tasks` is still read by nothing (`crates/nvs-config/src/default.toml` says so), and no gap owns that.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes (module doc of `tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`). A person has to push, so no session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` still names 53 gaps: `nvs-host` (1), `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-runtime` and `nvs-stdlib` the largest, plus `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`. Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", as the goal's § *Stage 4* defines it.

items.text: **A task that never waits is stopped at its group's deadline** — gap `a-task-that-never-waits-outlives-its-groups-deadline`, `rule:concurrency/limit-and-deadline-are-the-only-bounds`: `crates/nvs-host/src/group.rs:605` (`arm_deadline`) arms a reactor timer that a child looping without a call never lets fire, and the poll reads only the tree's word, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/safepoint.rs:59` (`share_safepoint_with`). It needs a per-group stop that a poll can read. First decide whether that is Stage 4's "too large". `tests/hostile/core/Task/all/03-tasks-that-never-wait.nvs` carries the gap's marker.

**`[limits] max_tasks` bounds the tasks a request has in flight, or the key is struck** — no gap yet: `crates/nvs-config/src/default.toml` documents it as read by nothing, and `crates/nvs-host/src/group.rs:452` (`run_as_children`) is where a count would be asked. Write a gap under `data/gaps/nvs-host/` first if it does not fit this session.
